name: users_by_reaction_anonymous
setup: INSERT INTO discourse_reactions_reactions (post_id, reaction_type, reaction_value, reaction_users_count, created_at, updated_at) SELECT 35, 0, 'clap', 0, now() - interval '60 minutes', now() - interval '60 minutes' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM discourse_reactions_reactions WHERE post_id = 35 AND reaction_value = 'clap')
UPDATE discourse_reactions_reactions SET reaction_users_count = reaction_users_count + 1 WHERE post_id = 35 AND reaction_value = 'clap'

INSERT INTO post_actions (post_id, user_id, post_action_type_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (35, 3, 2, now() - interval '60 minutes', now() - interval '60 minutes')
